    BO13a Lemma 5 a) for the other neighbour #

    MulBasis.lemma5a_mk restates Lemma 5 a) with the chain morphisms given by equations of RayMors. Applying it to the crown C.op.rev in Pᵒᵖ gives the mirror statement (MulBasis.lemma5a_last): if σ s is long, then ρ s (the neighbour with the same codomain) factors through a last arrow of any contour of σ s. The transfers of long morphisms and contours to Pᵒᵖ are RayCat.isLong_op_iff and RayCat.not_notInContour_unop.

    BO13a Lemma 5 a), dual form. If σ s is long in the chain of a crown, then ρ s factors through a last arrow of any contour of σ s.
